# Widgets

Every widget works in two ways. Put it in the `cards` list of a [`custom:houseview-card`](../configuration.md) carousel with `type: <widget type>`, or add it to any dashboard as a card of its own with the card type in the third column. All widgets accept `size` (`normal`, `wide`, `tall`, `large`) and, unless the page says otherwise, `name`. Single-button widgets also accept the [action options](../actions.md) `tap_action`, `hold_action` and `double_tap_action`.

| Widget | Widget type | Card type | Entity | Since |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Action](action.md) | `action` | `custom:houseview-action-card` | scene, script, button or input_button | 1.0 |
| [Clock](clock.md) | `clock` | `custom:houseview-clock-card` | none | 1.0 |
| [Date](date.md) | `date` | `custom:houseview-date-card` | none | 1.0 |
| [Camera](camera.md) | `camera` | `custom:houseview-camera-card` | required | 1.0 |
| [Thermostat](climate.md) | `climate` | `custom:houseview-climate-card` | required | 1.0 |
| [Light](light.md) | `light` | `custom:houseview-light-card` | required | 1.0 |
| [Switch](switch.md) | `switch` | `custom:houseview-switch-card` | required | 1.0 |
| [Fan](fan.md) | `fan` | `custom:houseview-fan-card` | required | 1.0 |
| [Blinds](cover.md) | `cover` | `custom:houseview-cover-card` | required | 1.0 |
| [Lock](lock.md) | `lock` | `custom:houseview-lock-card` | required | 1.0 |
| [Sensor](sensor.md) | `sensor` | `custom:houseview-sensor-card` | required | 1.0 |
| [Weather](weather.md) | `weather` | `custom:houseview-weather-card` | required | 1.0 |
| [Music](media_player.md) | `media_player` | `custom:houseview-media_player-card` | required | 1.0 |
| [Calendar](calendar.md) | `calendar` | `custom:houseview-calendar-card` | required | 1.0 |
| [Timer](timer.md) | `timer` | `custom:houseview-timer-card` | required | 1.0 |
| [Alarm panel](alarm_control_panel.md) | `alarm_control_panel` | `custom:houseview-alarm_control_panel-card` | required | 1.0 |
| [Vacuum](vacuum.md) | `vacuum` | `custom:houseview-vacuum-card` | required | 1.4 |

Besides the widgets above, [overview cards](../screensavers.md) paint a whole page, for example the [weather overview](../overviews/weather.md).
